en: A tinted historic postcard view of a large town square bordered by low, classical-style buildings and backed by forested hills. People in early-20th‑century clothing stroll and gather around the square; a small cart is visible in the foreground. On the left stands a prominent white building labeled on its pediment, and on the right a building with an iron balcony, under which hangs a sign for a barber shop. Printed at the top is the caption identifying the place as Piatra N., Piața-mare.
